d: Is bhag men vishnugupt takshashila se kaee varshon bad shiksha grahan ke uprant magadh lautte hain , aur apne ghar jate hain unka ghar puri tarah ujar chuka hai. jahan unhen vo bat yad aati hai jo bat jate samay unhonne man se kahi thi . usi samay vahan mahamantri shaktar bhi aa jate hai - phir kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men .
